versionImpact.rationale: Web-surface deploys now preserve declared immutable publication archives while retaining deletion for mutable site paths.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Publication archive roots are excluded from mutable deletion, existing immutable objects are digest-verified, missing objects use no-overwrite upload, and parent surface syncs carry the same preservation boundary.

summary: Buildchain v2.11 preserves immutable publication archives across preview, staging, and production web-surface deploys.
